description: This file contains functions and constants for testing Korean Hangul input via an Input Method Editor (IME) using Playwright. It includes a test phrase, a function to simulate typing Hangul characters, and a helper to decompose Hangul syllables into constituent jamo.

methods.name: typeKoreanWithIme
methods.description: Simulates typing a Korean Hangul phrase using an Input Method Editor via Chrome DevTools Protocol, handling composition and normalization.

methods.name: decomposeKorean
methods.description: Decomposes Hangul syllables into initial consonant, medial vowel, and optional final consonant (jamo).
